question: Who among the following Padma Bhushan awardee dancers was called to perform for the coronation festivities of Queen Elizabeth II?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kumari Kamala**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A classical **Bharatanatyam dancer, Kumari Kamala was invited to perform for the coronation of Queen Elizabeth II in 1953.**
 
• She was **awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2002.**
 
• She was instrumental in popularizing **Bharatanatyam abroad and performed in various countries, representing Indian classical dance at international platforms.**
 
• Her performances were known for their grace, precision, and emotional depth.
